title: Normalization of rational geometric Frobenius compact-support exchange
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, l a prime distinct from its characteristic, and E a finite extension of Q_l. Let f₀ : X₀ → Y₀ be a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type schemes over D.k₀ and c₀ a compactification. For each rational constructible K on the geometric fibre of X₀, the component of FrobeniusExchange.frobeniusRational for the compact recipe c₀ equals the hom of RationalWeilPurity.rationalExchange at K, with the specified endpoint transports. These are the constructions of [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange], [def-weil-operation-exchange-coefficient-descent] and [lem-pur-rational-weil-naturality-mate].

source.place: Step 2, the compact-support transport is the exchange for the same Cartesian square, followed by pushforward of the exceptional datum; rational localization of its proper/open construction.

proof.text: Apply frobeniusCompactIntegral_normalization to the integral representative K.obj. This is precisely the integral proper/open comparison, and uses no rational exchange specification.

Unfold frobeniusRational and modelRationalExchange. A generic functor-category equality-transport calculation shows its component is heterogeneously equal to localizedTransformation at K: eliminate the source and target functor equalities, then cancel the identity transports. Its component is the localization of the model integral exchange. The compact model selects frobeniusCompactIntegral. Apply localization.map to the equality from Step 1. Finally the choose_spec of rationalExchange_existsUnique identifies the other side with rationalExchange.hom; compose the two heterogeneous equalities.

from.place: The auxiliary compact-support exchange normalization required to compare the two rational presentations in the constant purity Frobenius square.

lean.statement:
theorem frobeniusCompactRational_normalization
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsSeparated f₀.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (c₀ : Compactification f₀.left)
    (K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E (D.geometricFiber X₀).left) :
    HEq ((FrobeniusExchange.frobeniusRational D l hl E f₀
      (FrobeniusExchange.frobeniusCompactModel D f₀ c₀)).app K)
      (RationalWeilPurity.rationalExchange D l hl f₀ E c₀ K).hom
